name: global-search-catalog-chefs
title: Unify global search for restaurants, dishes, categories, portions, cooking methods, and chefs
description: Fix the shared search contract end to end so desktop and mobile use one safe GraphQL flow, menu results include restaurant/category/portion/cooking metadata, and public chef profiles are searchable without exposing private staff phone numbers.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Keep OWNER admin-only. Chef results may match a restaurant contact phone but must never expose or search a staff personal phone in the public flow. Reuse the existing search resolver and Apollo hooks; add no dependency.
